name_en: Hebei Henghe Bangxing New Material Co., Ltd. (Changshan Fabric)
main_products: Workwear fabric (cotton/poly twill, dyed and coated), cotton lining and garment fabric, woven and dyed functional fabrics, yarn
woven_evidence: Its workwear fabric page lists woven poly-cotton specs (16x12 and 20x16 yarn counts, 200-300 gsm, 57/58 inch width), and its 138th Canton Fair news names woven and dyed fabrics.

canton_fair.evidence_note: The company news post announces it will exhibit at Phase 3 of the 138th Canton Fair (Oct 31-Nov 4, 2025) and show woven fabrics and dyed fabrics. It is also named in the texnet.com.cn list of Shijiazhuang exhibitors at the 137th fair.

notes: Its site links it to the Shijiazhuang Changshan textile group, listed in Shenzhen in 2000, and claims 2 bases and 5,054 staff. The site also sells yarn and home-textile fabric, and the stated address is an office building, so Layer 2 should check whether this company is the mill itself or its export arm.
